text: {"answer":"Quarrendon Freight Lines","citations":["D104","D004","D056","D106"],"explanation":"The July 28, 2025 update (D104) mentions travel expenses from \"Dana's freight account\" right after describing the Duluth trip for the Quarrendon QBR.
